body:
the very first line of Love Story (Taylor's Version) and my ear went OH. it's her. it's really her again 🥹

that's Taylor singing it from the balcony on the Speak Now tour in 2011, years before she took the song back.

your challenge tonight: open the Taylor's Version lens, find Fearless, and figure out where Love Story (Taylor's Version) was first heard before the album was even announced. the answer is so chaotic and i adore it.

send this to the friend who'll get it first.

why: Instagram sibling of the Nov 21 Taylor's Version hero. Different challenge from X: where Love Story (TV) was first heard. Answer in the lens: a December 2020 Match.com ad starring Ryan Reynolds, before the Feb 11 2021 Fearless (TV) announcement (rerecords.mjs rr-fearless). Share hook = who solves it first, grounded in the challenge.

critique.rationale: Leads with the first-listen feeling, then a concrete phone-sized task whose answer (the Dec 2020 Match.com ad) is on the Fearless card. The Love Story balcony photo is the song the challenge is about.
